sourceChrome.sentence: a vision insurance policy is not the same as health insurance.
regular health insurance plans protect you against financial losses due to unexpected eye injuries or disease.
vision insurance, on the other hand, is a wellness benefit designed to provide routine eye care prescription eyewear and other vision-related services at a reduced cost.
